Summary Collaboration Themes: Yeary and Havlicek collaborated on robust nonlinear target tracking across video, radar, acoustic sensor networks, and infrared imagery. Their work combined particle filtering with state-partition extended Kalman filtering, centralized power-aware sensor fusion, and adaptive histogram appearance learning. Key contributions include improved proposal distributions, reduced particle requirements, online noise variance estimation, and robust track lock under clutter, ego-motion, and nonstationary target signatures. This integration advanced sequential estimation, automatic target recognition, and practical tracking for defense, surveillance, robotics, and sensor-network applications.
